subject: Request: One-time pricing exception for SparkCharts pilot
messages:
From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@sparkcharts.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sparkcharts.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pricing and timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at SparkCharts is excited. We want to run a 60-day pilot across two internal product teams (approx. 2M tokens/month expected). Before we can proceed, Procurement asked if Redwood can offer a deeper one-time pilot discount — they are requesting a 40% reduction to the quoted commercial rate for the pilot period.

Our procurement note: if the pilot shows value, we expect to convert to a 12-month committed plan starting immediately after pilot completion. Can Redwood provide a one-time exception and a short addendum to capture the conversion terms?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rodriguez
VP, Platforms & Integrations
SparkCharts

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@sparkcharts.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing and timeline

Hi Elena — great to hear you're moving forward.

Quick context on our quote: list annualized is $120,000; standard entry-tier enterprise discount is 25%. For pilots we typically offer a 20-30% pilot concession depending on scope. A 40% one-time discount is outside our standard guardrails because pilot economics at that level materially change conversion thresholds.

That said, I will escalate to Finance/Commercial for a one-time exception. Can you confirm:
- Pilot start date target (you mentioned mid-August)
- Rough token cadence (you said ~2M tokens/month) and whether inference latency SLOs are required for both teams
- Any required security/compliance attachments for legal review (SOC2 scope, IP terms)

If you confirm those, I'll route an exception memo for VP/CFO sign-off and circle back within 48 hours.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SparkCharts pilot — request for 40% one-time discount (escalation)

Team — forwarding SparkCharts request. Quick summary below and attached deal packet.

Account: SparkCharts (data visualizations SaaS)
ARR potential: $120k-240k in year 1 depending on conversion scope
Pilot: 60-day pilot, ~2M tokens/month across 2 teams
Requested concession: 40% one-time discount on pilot period; procurement expects conversion to a 12-month committed contract immediately following pilot
Why this matters: High strategic logo in vertical, potential to expand to additional product lines and is referenced by a large analytics partner. Competitive pressure: another vendor quoted deeper pilot discounts.

Ask: need VP/CFO sign-off for an exception memo. Proposal options I recommend:
- Option A (conservative): Approve 30% pilot concession. Require MRR conversion target (>=$8k MRR) within 45 days of pilot end, and an executed 12-month commitment.
- Option B (aggressive, aligns with request): Approve 40% one-time pilot concession with explicit conversion covenant: minimum 6-month committed spend of $50k within 60 days of pilot end + credit terms adjusted to Net30 and no SLA credits during pilot.

Attachments: DealSummary_SparkCharts_Q3.pdf, PricingGrid_v3.xlsx

If approved, I'll: 1) draft the exception memo for signatures, 2) update HubSpot and attach the memo, 3) send a limited-scope addendum to SparkCharts for signature.

- Soojin

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SparkCharts pilot — request for 40% one-time discount (escalation)

Thanks for the clear summary, Soojin. I reviewed the deck and the revenue profile. I'm comfortable approving an exception on the following conditional basis (this will serve as the CFO sign-off):

- Approve Option B with a 40% one-time pilot concession limited to the 60-day pilot period only.
- Conditions:
  * Customer must execute the addendum committing to a minimum 6-month spend of $50,000 (total) within 60 days after pilot completion, or the pilot concession will convert to a one-time invoice for the discount amount.
  * No SLA credit liabilities during pilot window.
  * Finance to be copied on the signed addendum; revenue will be recognized on a contract basis per ASC guidance.
  * Legal to include a short conversion covenant clause and commit-to-purchase language in the addendum.

Please prepare the exception memo and include this language verbatim. I will sign once the memo is attached in HubSpot and legal confirms the addendum text.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
CFO (acting) | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@sparkcharts.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@sparkcharts.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sparkcharts.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: one-time pilot concession — next steps

Hi Elena / Daniel — good news: Finance/CFO has approved the one-time 40% concession for the 60-day pilot, pending signature of a short addendum capturing the conversion covenant. Key terms below (this mirrors the exception memo):

- Pilot concession: 40% one-time discount applied to pilot invoice only (60 days)
- Conversion condition: Customer commits to a minimum 6-month spend of $50,000 (total) within 60 days of pilot completion. If unmet, the discount amount will be invoiced to the customer as a one-time charge.
- Operational notes: No SLA credits during pilot. Finance will recognize per contract; legal will add conversion clause to the addendum.

I have attached the signed exception memo and a draft addendum for legal review. Please review the addendum and if acceptable, sign via the link below so we can lock timelines and provision dedicated capacity for the pilot.
